description_en: Queries some default configuration parameters of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的部分默认配置参数信息
name: DescribeInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Config.description_en: The default configuration parameters of the instance. For more comprehensive parameter settings, call the [DescribeParameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473847.html） operation
Config.description_zh: 实例的默认配置参数，更全面的参数配置请调用[Describeparamters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473847.html）接口

ParamNoLooseSentinelEnabled.description_en:
The Sentinel compatibility mode. This parameter applies to non-cluster instances. Valid values:

no (default): disabled.
yes: enabled.
For more information, see [Sentinel compatibility mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
ParamNoLooseSentinelEnabled.description_zh:
哨兵兼容模式，适用于非集群实例。取值说明：
no（默认）：未开启
yes：开启
更多信息请参见[Sentinel兼容模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）

ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess.description_en:
Specifies whether to allow password-free execution of Sentinel-related commands when Sentinel mode is enabled. Valid values:

no (default): disabled.
yes: enabled. After this parameter is enabled, you can run Sentinel commands without a password on any connection and use the SENTINEL command to listen on the +switch-master channel
ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess.description_zh:
开启哨兵模式时，是否允许免密执行Sentinel相关命令，取值说明：
no（默认）：关闭。
yes：开启。开启后，可以在任意连接上免密执行Sentinel命令以及使用SENTINEL命令监听+switch-master通道

ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeCommands.description_en: After Sentinel mode and the ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess parameter are enabled, you can use this parameter to add additional password-free commands to the list. The default value is empty
ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeCommands.description_zh: 启用哨兵模式及ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess参数后，可通过本参数添加额外的免密命令列表（默认为空）

ParamReplMode.description_en:
The synchronization mode. Valid values:

async (default): asynchronous mode.
semisync: semi-synchronous mode
ParamReplMode.description_zh:
同步模式：
async（默认）：异步模式
semisync：半同步模式

ParamReplTimeout.description_en:
The degradation threshold for semi-synchronous mode. This parameter can be configured only in semi-synchronous mode. Unit: ms. Valid values: 10 to 60000. Default value: 500.
When the synchronization latency exceeds this threshold, the synchronization mode automatically switches to asynchronous mode. When the synchronization latency is eliminated, the synchronization mode automatically switches back to semi-synchronous mode
ParamReplTimeout.description_zh:
半同步模式的降级阈值。仅半同步支持配置该参数，单位为ms，取值范围为10~60000，默认为500。
当同步延迟超出该阈值时，同步模式会自动转为异步，当同步延迟消除后，同步模式会自动转换为半同步

ParamSentinelCompatEnable.description_en:
The Sentinel compatibility mode. This parameter applies to instances that use the proxy connection mode in cluster architecture or the read/write splitting architecture. Valid values:

0 (default): disabled.
1: enabled.
For more information, see [Sentinel compatibility mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
ParamSentinelCompatEnable.description_zh:
哨兵兼容模式，适用于集群架构代理连接模式或读写分离架构的实例，取值说明：
0（默认）：未开启
1：开启
更多信息请参见[Sentinel兼容模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
